_README: One object per meeting; the site sorts by date. Fields: id (unique, no spaces), title (optional: leave '' and the card says "Club Meeting"), date (YYYY-MM-DD), tags (list, optional), description (optional one line), coverImage (optional, e.g. 'assets/slides/java-basics.webp'), slidesUrl (paste the Google Slides/PDF link AFTER the meeting; leave '' until then), availableFrom (optional ISO datetime; defaults to the meeting date at MEETING.endTime24 in config.js).
